unspecified_scores.reason: Confirmed at PdfPagesPanel.tsx:139-157. The rootMargin uses the scroller's visible height when the observer is created, and the dependencies are only [firstRatio, state.numPages]. Resizing the window, or a phone sheet that is still moving when the rail mounts, leaves the pre-draw margin too large or too small. The only effect is that thumbnails start drawing a little earlier or later than intended; pages inside the visible box still intersect and are drawn.

Confirmed at PdfPagesPanel.tsx:197-219 and 311-319. The cap check reads only `drawn.size`, and an `entered` page leaves only through eviction or failure. A fast scroll through a 200+ page PDF can therefore mount more than 120 <Page> renders at once. The user may see a short CPU or memory spike and slower drawing, and the effect trims the drawn set back to 120 once those renders finish.

specification_compliance: I3: the observer at PdfPagesPanel.tsx:142-151 uses the scroller from scrollerOf with a rootMargin of half the visible height. This matches the rule as written, but the margin is fixed when the observer is created (unspecified index 0).
I3/I8 cap: eviction at PdfPagesPanel.tsx:197-219 trims `drawn` to 120 in an effect after commit. Cells in `drawing` are not capped (unspecified index 1).

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: A page enters `entered` when it intersects the extended box and only leaves through eviction or failure (PdfPagesPanel.tsx:148, 218, 260). Scrolling past a page without stopping still commits it to a full render.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Flinging the rail of a long PDF queues renders for every page passed over, so the pages the user lands on can be drawn later than they would otherwise be.

regression_risks: Changing the observer effect's dependencies, for example adding the scroller height, would recreate the observer. The new observer re-reports every intersecting cell; that is harmless because adding a page to `entered` is idempotent.
test_coverage: I did not read the unit tests or the e2e specs to see whether the transient overshoot of the 120 cap, or a resize after mount, is exercised.
not_verified: Rendering behaviour in a real browser: I could not run the code or the tests.
